text: Expenses over $50 need a receipt (every expense outside the US).
A single item over $5,000 cannot be expensed; it goes through procurement.
Claims more than 90 days after the purchase need manager approval.
Flights, trains, rental cars and lodging booked outside Navan need manager approval.
Flights and trains booked less than 14 days ahead need manager approval.
Rental cars and lodging booked less than 7 days ahead need manager approval.
Lodging over $300 a night including tax needs manager approval.
Meals are reimbursable only while traveling, at team events, or with clients and partners.
Meals for yourself while traveling are reimbursable up to $120 a day.
Team events and meals are limited to $80 per person per meal.
Meals with clients and partners are limited to $80 per person.
Nothing of value, including meals, may be provided to government officials.
Taxis and rideshares over $150 a trip, or $300 a round trip, need manager approval.
Parking and tolls over $150 a day need manager approval.
Internet while traveling is reimbursable up to $50 a day.
Home internet is reimbursable up to $100 a month with an itemized receipt.
Phone service is reimbursable up to $100 a month with an itemized receipt.
Co-working day passes, up to 5 days a month, are reimbursable up to $100 a day without approval.
More than 5 co-working days a month needs manager and finance pre-approval and is capped at $700 a month.
New hires get a $1,500 home-office stipend in their first year; nothing above it is reimbursed.
After the first year, home-office equipment is a $500 yearly refresh; nothing above it is reimbursed.
Laptops and laptop repairs go through an approved IT issue.
Phones, tablets, watches, smart speakers, smart TVs, routers and treadmills are not reimbursable.
Office supplies and consumables are reimbursable up to $50 a month.
Books are reimbursable up to $60 a year.
Conferences, training, tuition and professional dues need an approved Growth & Development issue.
Team member gifts and flowers are capped at $125 including shipping.
Postage and shipping over $100 a transaction need manager approval.
Software subscriptions and personal VPNs are never reimbursed; software goes through procurement.
Swag and giveaways are never expensed.
International flights booked less than 21 days ahead need manager approval.
Premium economy needs every flight segment over 5 hours, or manager approval for travelers over 6'5" (2 m).
Business class is only for frequent international travelers (3+ trips a quarter) on segments over 8 hours, meeting customers, speaking or representing GitLab at a conference.
First class flights are never reimbursed.
Trains are standard class; one class up only for frequent rail travelers (more than 3 trips a quarter) on rides over 5 hours.
Rental cars are reimbursable up to intermediate class.
Fuel and EV charging are reimbursable up to $300 a day.
Mileage and fuel or EV charging cannot both be claimed for the same trip.
Mileage cannot be claimed when driving a rental car; claim the fuel instead.
Tips are acceptable up to 20% of the bill.
Cash and gift cards are never allowed as gifts.
Baby gifts are not reimbursable; GitLab already sends one.
Holiday gifts for your team are bought personally, not expensed.
Staying with friends or family instead of a hotel, you may expense a host gift up to $50.
Business cards over $150 a quarter need manager approval.
Dry cleaning is reimbursable only on hotel stays over 5 nights.
Internet and phone setup, installation, hardware, change fees and insurance are not reimbursable.
On a family plan, only your own line is reimbursable.
Visas, travel permits and Covid tests need AP Admin approval.
Internet, phone, co-working and other monthly work expenses are not reimbursable while on leave.
Co-working is not reimbursable during personal travel.
